 The 179th Cyberspace Wing, Mansfield Ohio ANG Contracting Office is issuing this Solicitation notice for Project No's: PBXP 272018 – B422 Breakroom, and PBXP 272019 - B300 BDOC. Bids will be evaluated in accordance with RFO FAR 14.306. Bids will be evaluated without discussions. Award will be made in accordance with RFO FAR 14.307(b). 

 This project is solicited as SET ASIDE FOR SMALL BUSINESSES, 100%. 

 All responsible bidders are encouraged to participate. The North American Industry Classification (NAICS) Code is 236220, with a size standard of $45,000,000 average annual revenue for the previous three (3) years. 

 The magnitude is between $0.00 and $150,000.00. 

 See Sec 00 21 00 - Instructions, for pertinent details and instructions related to site visit. Interested contractors are highly encouraged to attend and shall follow conference registration and base access requirements shown in the solicitation. The bid opening date is currently scheduled for 10 December 2026, at 1:00pm (EST). Please ensure Request for Information template/outline is utitilized for all questions related to this project; template is located within Section 00 21 00 - Instructions. 
Interested bidders shall be registered in System for Award Management (SAM). To register go to: https://www.sam.gov. Instructions for registering are on the web page. The solicitation and associated information and the plans and specifications will be available only through Contract Opportunities located within SAM.gov website online at https://www.sam.gov. SAM.gov is a web-based dissemination tool designed to safeguard acquisition-related information for all Federal agencies. The project site is located at the 179th Cyberspace Wing,Mansfield, Ohio 44903. Any questions should be emailed to the following:Gordon Strom, gordon.strom.1@us.af.mil.
